title: Refund-confidentiality access rules in the pilot
scope: Move refund-confidentiality access rules from later to the pilot: refund case data is visible only to assigned refund roles, with denied access tested and logged

acceptance.text: Role and case rules restrict refund data; cross-role and cross-case access is denied and logged
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

evidence.text: ADR-049: a refund case (submission_type refund_claim) is visible only to service identities, refund-team supervisors (Vati Tenant Membership.refund_team) and the refund-team auditor/specialist assigned in Vati Case Assignment (assigned only by a refund-team supervisor). Enforced in Desk (list query conditions and has_permission for every case/submission-keyed DocType), /api/v1 (all case operations gated, listCases filtered) and the case-scoped whitelisted endpoints. Each refusal is sealed into the tenant audit ledger as <action>.denied with outcome refund_confidentiality. Disposable site verify-20261112t061221: refund_access/test_refund_access_bench 6/6 OK (cross-role: plain auditor, plain supervisor, unassigned refund auditor denied; cross-case: reassignment removes access; ledger entries; Desk lists/opens; api_v1 403 and hidden from list; assignment rules); identity/test_policy 34 OK.

Disposable site (frappe_dev.py verify): install and two migrations ok; bench suite 236 tests, failing only reminders/test_reminders_bench (pre-existing on main); bridge bench updated so a refund claim's mirror is hidden from an auditor outside the refund team (15/15 OK). Frappe-free: backend discovery 592 with only the pre-existing Windows path-separator failure in portal/test_presubmission; tests/integration and tests/contracts OK; ruff, ruff format, mypy and validate.py clean. Hosted CI does not start (org spending limit).
